description: This file defines an interface for retrieving hardware-specific information related to the System on Chip (SoC), such as GPU memory and graphics dimensions. It contains function declarations for querying total and free GPU RAM, as well as graphics width and height.

methods.name: SoC_GetTotalGpuRam
methods.description: Returns the total GPU memory available in bytes.

methods.name: SoC_GetFreeGpuRam
methods.description: Returns the current free GPU memory in bytes.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the graphics plane in pixels.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the graphics plane in pixels.
